sourceName: Documoto Equipment Parts Book Phase 2 Pilot

machines.renderProvenance: Documoto equipment parts-book viewer reference for phase 2 validation.
machines.licenseNote: Phase 2 pilot stores provider links and metadata only. Confirm Documoto account/export terms before caching diagrams, parts books, or customer equipment data.

assemblySteps.title: Confirm equipment parts book
assemblySteps.instructions: Verify model, serial range, revision, and parts-book source before BOM generation.
assemblySteps.qualityCheck: Equipment identity and parts-book revision are recorded.

assemblySteps.title: Map exploded-view assemblies
assemblySteps.instructions: Use the provider parts-book view to group rollers, belt, guarding, drive, sensing, and enclosure items into build-sheet steps.
assemblySteps.qualityCheck: Build sheet reflects whole-machine assemblies, not isolated component guesses.

assemblySteps.title: Queue service documentation review
assemblySteps.instructions: Carry Documoto source links, serial applicability, and reviewer notes into the quote packet for admin/vendor review.
assemblySteps.qualityCheck: Reviewer can trace each BOM line back to the provider parts-book reference.

modelingVendors.serviceType: equipment rebuild quote and fabrication review
